lines: To thee, Death's bourne, Love's bruiser, wave-crowned pate,
right-worker meet: hail.
sanskrit_cite: namaḥ kṛtakṛtāntānta tubhyaṃ madanamardine mastakanyastagaṅgāya yathāyuktārthakāriṇe

lines: O'er sway and ken, past passion, past writ stands prayed-for poise —
sundered from thee, what haven higher for the prayerful?
sanskrit_cite: aiśvaryajñānavairāgyadharmebhyo 'py upari sthitim nātha prārthayamānānāṃ tvad ṛte kā parā gatiḥ

lines: Shouldst thou not list it, Śambhu, who could crook a straw?
graced by thy list, who would shirk heaven's yoke?
sanskrit_cite: tvayy anicchati kaḥ śambho śaktaḥ kubjayituṃ tṛṇam tvadicchānugṛhītas tu vahed brāhmīṃ dhuraṃ na kaḥ

lines: Brain-rich, crests high with bending's gem-wreaths to Hara —
to what Utmost kneel they, whom unbowed?
sanskrit_cite: harapraṇatimāṇikyamukuṭotkaṭamastakāḥ nameyuḥ kaṃ paraṃ kaṃ vā namayeyur na dhīdhanāḥ

lines: Still, strayless, honeymere — midmost thy ken-sea —
may I settle, Matted-Crown.
sanskrit_cite: sarvavibhramanirmokaniṣkampam amṛtahradam bhavajjñānāmbudher madhyam adhyāsīyāpi dhūrjaṭe

lines: A marvel — eyed awry, fancy-astray though it be —
ripe last yield, Lord, grant whole.
sanskrit_cite: citraṃ yac citradṛṣṭo 'pi manorathagato 'pi vā paramārthaphalaṃ nātha paripūrṇaṃ prayacchasi

lines: What thewed outtops thee? What stringless tops thee?
So, Lord, we hymn — bless, blame thee? We weet not.
sanskrit_cite: ko guṇair adhikas tvattas tvattaḥ ko nirguṇo 'dhikaḥ iti nātha numaḥ kiṃ tvāṃ kiṃ nindāmo na manmahe

lines: Though hymning but the honey-spate whose grace fruits in thee —
to quaff, what stranger meet? To ladle — world-Lord, who then?
sanskrit_cite: kīrtane 'py amṛtaughasya yatprasatteḥ phalaṃ tava tat pātum api ko 'nyo 'laṃ kim u dātuṃ jagatpate

lines: From the garner where all cravings sheaf to ripeness —
from thee one alms I sue, Lord, in all wise: love of thee lone to gain.
sanskrit_cite: niḥśeṣaprārthanīyārthasārthasiddhinidhānataḥ tvattas tvadbhaktim evāptuṃ prārthaye nātha sarvathā

lines: Hail triple-earth's king, hail thee, Becoming — hailed of thy haunters —
hail the unlet might that triples kingship.
sanskrit_cite: namas trailokyanāthāya tubhyaṃ bhava bhavajjuṣām trilokīnāthatādānanirvināyakaśaktaye

lines: When men moot what uproots all ache — master, 'that thou art' resolved —
who fled not to thee for hold?
sanskrit_cite: niḥśeṣakleśahānasya hetuḥ ka iti saṃśaye svāmin so 'sīti niścitya kas tvāṃ na śaraṇaṃ gataḥ

lines: Tasted and done with seeming's goods, the top seat I shall attain —
so runs hope: bright may it burn for Śambhu's lover.
sanskrit_cite: bhuktvā bhogān bhavabhrāntiṃ hitvā lapsye paraṃ padam ity āśaṃseha śobheta śambhau bhaktimataḥ param

lines: Lord, in slumber e'en whatso I work or word, foul or fair —
prideful hang I on thee — at home in all, content.
sanskrit_cite: nātha svapne 'pi yat kuryāṃ brūyāṃ vā sādhv asādhu vā tvadadhīnatvadarpeṇa sarvatrātrāsmi nirvṛtaḥ

lines: What lamp 'mid lamps — there, where mind courses in thy close —
mind's lord, shall murk e'er touch? As lief the barren's grandson.
sanskrit_cite: jyotiṣām api yaj jyotis tatra tvaddhāmni dhāvataḥ cittasyeśa tamaḥsparśo manye vandhyātmajānujaḥ

lines: Methinks one foot already on kind release's causeway stands —
whose hankering holds: 'Śiva will I serve' — ev'n this.
sanskrit_cite: manye nyastapadaḥ so 'pi kṣemye mokṣasya vartmani manorathaḥ sthito yasya seviṣye śivam ity ayam

lines: Through keep, kindle, kill, in triple-earth's errands here —
sole indeed, Lord, thy sway — loose — thou eyest the web.
sanskrit_cite: sthityutpattilayair lokatrayasyopakriyāsv iha ekaiveśa bhavacchaktiḥ svatantraṃ tantram īkṣase

lines: Saved in the triple here who — by triple smart unseared —
to him hail be, to thee: thou who art that dead-quiet honeymere.
sanskrit_cite: trilokyām iha kas trātas tritāpyā nopatāpitaḥ tasmai namo 'stu te yas tvaṃ tannirvāṇāmṛtahradaḥ

lines: Feat love, though feigned, fruits unfeigned — were it straight,
what yield? — utter it thou.
sanskrit_cite: kṛtrimāpi bhavadbhaktir akṛtrimaphalodayā niśchadmā ced bhaved eṣā kiṃphaleti tvayocyatām

lines: That optic spying thee, that highway wending thee —
that yield, Birthless, is born of tale-tree about thee.
sanskrit_cite: tac cakṣur īkṣyase yena sā gatir gamyase yayā phalaṃ tad aja jātaṃ yat tvatkathākalpapādapāt

lines: Good past good indeed this poise aloft in thee —
to sweep its bars, Lord, be thou my hold.
sanskrit_cite: śreyasā śreya evaitad upari tvayi yā sthitiḥ tadantarāyahṛtaye tvam īśa śaraṇaṃ mama

lines: Ah, sweetest the foretaste of waiting on the Gracious —
where, in what tick of time, turns it not ever-new?
sanskrit_cite: aho svādutamaḥ śarvasevāśaṃsāsudhārasaḥ kutra kālakalāmātre na yo navanavāyate

lines: Ever unflagging, peopling the triple sphere with hundred fancies —
yet single, seamless, triumphs the Birthless.
sanskrit_cite: muhur muhur aviśrāntas trailokyaṃ kalpanāśataiḥ kalpayann api ko 'py eko nirvikalpo jayaty ajaḥ

lines: By lore-lamp licking the birth-greased wont-wick clean —
God, O when may I stand in thy sight, prithee?
sanskrit_cite: malatailāktasaṃsāravāsanāvartidāhinā jñānadīpena deva tvāṃ kadā nu syām upasthitaḥ

lines: For but a blink, with faults outworn, lodge thy tread in heart —
then what, Śambhu, beyond thy compass?
sanskrit_cite: nimeṣam api yady ekaṃ kṣīṇadoṣe kariṣyasi padaṃ citte tadā śambho kiṃ na sampādayiṣyasi

lines: 'Blest I, quit I, mighty I am' — firm may that fancy stand —
his whom thou groundest, Lord.
sanskrit_cite: dhanyo 'smi kṛtakṛtyo 'smi mahān asmīti bhāvanā bhavet sālambanā tasya yas tvadālambanaḥ prabho

lines: All fair and foul thou makest thyself — yet love of thee
mothers the fair alone, solely, Lord.
sanskrit_cite: śubhāśubhasya sarvasya svayaṃ kartā bhavān api bhavadbhaktis tu jananī śubhasyaiveśa kevalam

lines: Mind pellucid, Master — steppest thou within, or clears it
at thy stepping? Man dangles thus.
sanskrit_cite: prasanne manasi svāmin kiṃ tvaṃ niviśase kim u tvatpraveśāt prasīdet tad iti dolāyate janaḥ

lines: Nay, here stands sure — thy oversight and only thine:
mind's favour, Master, is fulfilment, the remotest seat.
sanskrit_cite: niścayaḥ punar eṣo 'tra tvadadhiṣṭhānam eva hi prasādo manasaḥ svāmin sā siddhis tat paraṃ padam

lines: Word, wit, work, this frame of mine, Lord — by grace of thee
gleam love-trimmed for thee sole.
sanskrit_cite: vacaś cetaś ca kāryaṃ ca śarīraṃ mama yat prabho tvatprasādena tad bhūyād bhavadbhāvaikabhūṣaṇam

lines: This wish-jewel of praise, heavy with granted longing,
love's fortune-house — Bhaṭṭa Nārāyaṇa wrought it for Śambhu.
sanskrit_cite: stavacintāmaṇiṃ bhūrimanorathaphalapradam bhaktilakṣmyālayaṃ śambho bhaṭṭanārāyaṇo vyadhāt
notes: 2026-11-04 owner verdict: laud-gem/gravid struck as imported ugliness (vighna); restored T1 wish-jewel/longing/home (pada order kept).
